text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Oh, no, it's nothing. I just<n>haven't been
sleeping well of late.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky found me taking a nap<n>the other day.
She says I was talking<n>in my sleep about student
council<n>business.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Even in my dreams, I have no respite<n>from my
duties, it seems.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps that's why I feel as though<n>I've hardly
slept at all. Frankly, I<n>struggle to discern whether
I'm<n>dreaming or awake.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like Symboli Rudolf's lack<n>of proper sleep
is becoming a real<n>problem...
